conversation.content: Let's start a cart for Maya Chen.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart", "value": {"customer": {"name": "Maya Chen"}}}]
Add a pair of noise-canceling earbuds at $79.99 each, and put 1 in the cart.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items", "value": [{"product": "Noise-Canceling Earbuds", "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 79.99}]}]
Show the earbuds adding $79.99 to the cart before anything else is counted.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/0/lineAmount", "value": 79.99}]
Add 2 cork yoga blocks at $24.50 each.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/-", "value": {"product": "Cork Yoga Block", "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": 24.5}}]
Show the yoga blocks adding $49.00 to the cart.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/1/lineAmount", "value": 49}]
Add 3 packs of screen-cleaning wipes at $4.00 each.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/-", "value": {"product": "Screen-Cleaning Wipes", "quantity": 3, "unitPrice": 4}}]
Show the wipes adding $12.00 to the cart.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/2/lineAmount", "value": 12}]
Free shipping should kick in at $150, and until then shipping is a flat $8.95.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/shippingPolicy", "value": {"freeShippingThreshold": 150, "flatShippingFee": 8.95}}]
Now calculate the cart charges with those items and the shipping rule applied.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/charges", "value": {"subtotal": 140.99, "shippingFee": 8.95, "total": 149.94}}]
Ship it to Maya's apartment at 1842 Spruce Street in Denver, Colorado.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/delivery/address", "value": {"street": "1842 Spruce Street", "city": "Denver", "state": "CO"}}]
Use 80202 for the Denver address, and make it in the United States.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/delivery/address/postalCode", "value": "80202"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/cart/delivery/address/country", "value": "US"}]
Add Maya's contact info so the store can send updates: maya.chen@example.com and 303-555-0184.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/customer/contact", "value": {"email": "maya.chen@example.com", "phone": "303-555-0184"}}]
Use standard USPS Ground Advantage delivery, with an expected arrival of February 12, 2026.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/delivery/method", "value": {"carrier": "USPS", "service": "Ground Advantage", "estimatedArrival": "2026-02-12"}}]
Have Maya pay with a Visa ending in 4242, billed to 80202.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/payment", "value": {"brand": "Visa", "last4": "4242", "billingPostalCode": "80202"}}]
Mark this as cart MC-2026-0147, created on February 3, 2026, and keep it active.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/session", "value": {"cartId": "MC-2026-0147", "createdDate": "2026-02-03", "status": "active"}}]
For delivery, leave the package at the front desk, skip the signature, and send updates by text.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/delivery/preferences", "value": {"dropOffLocation": "front desk", "signatureRequired": false, "notificationChannel": "SMS"}}]
Add the product codes for the three items so the warehouse can pick them correctly.

[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/0/sku", "value": "AUD-NC-8831"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/1/sku", "value": "FIT-CORK-2042"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/2/sku", "value": "CLN-WIPE-1108"}]
Note the colors customers picked: black for the earbuds, natural cork for the blocks, and white for the wipes.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/0/color", "value": "black"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/1/color", "value": "natural cork"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/cart/items/2/color", "value": "white"}]
Add simple gift message details: make it a gift, say “Enjoy your new gear!”, and don’t show prices on the packing slip.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/giftOptions", "value": {"isGift": true, "message": "Enjoy your new gear!", "hidePrices": true}}]
Mark Maya as a repeat shopper interested in wellness items, with low fraud risk.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/customerProfile", "value": {"shopperType": "repeat", "interestCategory": "wellness", "riskLevel": "low"}}]
Add that Maya prefers minimal packaging.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/cart/customerNote", "value": "prefers minimal packaging"}]

edit_instruction: Change the screen-cleaning wipes quantity to 6 packs.
annotation_notes: Screen-cleaning wipes quantity 3->6. lineAmount 6*4=24; subtotal 79.99+49+24=152.99. The new subtotal crosses the $150 free-shipping threshold (was 140.99, below -> now 152.99, at/above), so shippingFee flips 8.95->0; total 152.99 (NOT 161.94, which would keep the flat fee). unitPrice, threshold/flat fee, other items, and descriptive fields stay.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a cart whose subtotal sums its line amounts, carrying a stated free-shipping threshold and a stated flat shipping fee that applies only while the subtotal is below the threshold and drops to zero once the subtotal reaches it, with a total that is the subtotal plus the shipping fee, so the line amounts determine the subtotal, the shipping fee, and the total. State the threshold and the flat fee in the conversation, and set the initial subtotal on one side of the threshold so the shipping fee is in its corresponding state. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a cart would carry that do not depend on the subtotal, and vary their number from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Change one line item's quantity or unit price to a specific new value chosen so the subtotal moves across the stated free-shipping threshold.
cascade_pattern: Editing the line re-derives its amount and then the subtotal; whether the new subtotal reaches the stated threshold determines the shipping fee (zero at or above the threshold, the stated flat fee below it), and the total re-sums the subtotal plus the shipping fee. Lines and fields that do not feed the subtotal stay. This is determined because the threshold and the flat fee are stated in the conversation.
